title: Larry Lucie and Armstrong's band
summary: Guitarist Larry Lucie was his roommate in Armstrong's band, and they practiced daily.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Would you play with a guitarist like Larry Lucie?
He told me the other day that he was going to come by and see youx because he hadn't been by in a long time.

Any time he knows where I'm playing. He'll do it every time. ... and we used to practice in Louis Armstrong's band practically every day. We weren't doing anything, I'd say, OK, let's play. He loved to play. And, can play.
